svg.title: Four interpolation kernels rebuilding the same samples
svg.desc: Top: ten samples with a sharp step are reconstructed by nearest neighbour (steps), bilinear (straight segments), bicubic (smooth with small overshoot) and Lanczos-3 (sharpest, with ringing). Bottom: the input samples each kernel reads for one output pixel P: 1, 4, 16 and 36.
svg.text: Shaded band = the sharp step between samples 3 and 4. Dashed line = the highest sample value; curves above it overshoot.
P (red ×) = one output pixel mapped back into the input; it lands between input samples (dots).
Filled dots are the samples each kernel reads when enlarging. Anti-aliased shrinking widens every kernel by the scale factor.
